source_receipts.finding: NIST AI 600-1 remains the official Generative AI Profile resource; publication date July 26, 2024; page updated April 8, 2026.
NIST states AI RMF 1.0 is being revised as part of the White House AI Action Plan.
The AI RMF 1.0 is being updated and a revised version is in progress.

rationale: NIST AI 600-1 remains a valid official GenAI Profile, but its companion AI RMF 1.0 is still under active revision. The candidate caveat remains accurate, yet the dependency is not stable enough to open a content-draft, canary or promotion path without risking immediately stale framing.

re_review_trigger.condition: Re-review when NIST publishes a revised AI RMF replacing 1.0 or explicitly states the active revision is complete/stable enough for profile-context reuse.
